cues: To get past the wall you need chemistry: reflux rectified spirit with quicklime, which takes up the water as calcium hydroxide, and distil.
That gives absolute alcohol, one hundred percent.
Industry uses azeotropic distillation with benzene.
And never calcium chloride, which forms a compound with ethanol.
